_note: VK-TERRAIN-NEAR-ORACLE-1: deterministic near-camera terrain oracle. Low-altitude ground-framing poses over the werewolf solid-terrain land region. Run with MC2_TERRAIN_LOD_CHUNK_FORCE_LOD=0 on BOTH GL and VK so every drawn block is lodStep==1 -> VK terrain island co-writes a large pixel region -> anti-tile/POM near-detail signal is exercised. Sim-frozen bookmark sweep => byte-stable across runs (both configs). FORCE_LOD is a LOD policy applied identically to GL and VK, NOT a VK gate, so the GL-vs-VK compare stays same-camera / like-for-like.

bookmarks.name: lodfade_midband
bookmarks._note: VK-TERRAIN-LODFADE seam-pose: camDist (ground distance + 0.7*altBoost, terrain_tier1.frag mv_computeLodNear) placed near the middle of the fade band [LODFADE_NEAR=4000, LODFADE_NEAR_FADE=4500]. Same XY area as near_land_low/near_land_off (known height-stable ground on mc2_01 -- avoids the mc2_24 land-follow altitude-divergence pitfall) but pulled back+up so camDist ~= 4250wu, i.e. lodNear ~= 0.5 (mid-fade) when MC2_VK_TERRAIN_LODFADE=1.
